description: Make the most of your nursery space with the West Lake Chest. This tall, graceful storage piece offers generous drawer space in a vertical footprint that fits beautifully in any room. Dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides keep clothing and accessories organized and accessible. Solid hardwood construction with a warm Brown Maple finish ensures lasting beauty. Coordinates with the full West Lake collection. Non-toxic baby-safe finish.
